description: Lists which destination countries and service levels Courio can mail a physical paper letter to, with an indicative "from" price (EUR including VAT, 1 black-and-white page), typical delivery time and the legal product name. No account or API key is needed. Call it before quote_letter to check a destination is served; pass a country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. "DE") to narrow the answer. Service levels: "standard" (ordinary mail, no proof), "tracked" (tracking only), "registered" (registered mail: proof of deposit), "registered_ar" (registered with acknowledgement of receipt: proof of delivery, the one to use for legal notices).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "DE"; omit for every country

name: get_coverage
title: Check coverage and indicative prices
